messages.author: 2ef256a129b97763
messages.subject: ShinyApp Bug reporting
parts:
Hi

I've just published my app on ShinyApp.  Very exciting!

These are the problems I have:

1. page "Introduction"  My sankey diagram does not show.  It shows running the app on my laptop or publishing on my Shiny Server locally though.  I get a javascript error (visible on the page): 
[Error] SyntaxError: JSON Parse error: Unexpected identifier "NA"
dispatchMessage (shiny.js, line 812)
onmessage (shiny.js, line 539)
onmessage (shiny-server-pro.js, line 346)
dispatchEvent (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
_dispatchMessage (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
_didMessage (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
onmessage (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
dispatchEvent (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
onchunk (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
emit (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)
onreadystatechange (sockjs-0.3.min.js, line 27)

2. the page /Crime Analysis/heat map/ has an error.  This is actually a bug of shiny (I believe) that I've reported in the shiny mailing list.

The app is here:

https://smartinsightsfromdata.shinyapps.io/TCleveland/

Please let me know!

Again: shiny and ShinyApps are FANTASTIC products! 

Thanks Enzo

messages.subject: Re: ShinyApp Bug reporting
parts:
One more issue reported by one of my users: charts / graphs do to work with IE8 or IE9, but only with Firefox 12.

I thought that IE9 was certified for Shiny Server?

Thanks Enzo

messages.subject: Re: ShinyApp Bug reporting
parts:
I managed to fix the problem with the sankey chart with 
options(shiny.transcode.json = FALSE)   - from an old post on the Shiny Server mailing list
in the server.R.   It is confusing as it is different behaviour depending if you are in rstudio desktop / rstudio server and shiny and shinyapp.
Thanks!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: ShinyApp Bug reporting
parts:
It looks the problem is that the browser is blocking javascript calls to non-https scripts. You need to make sure you're loading any javascript via https.

-Andy
